_CORRECTION.status: PURE_STRUCT_PARTITION_EXPERIMENT_WARRANTED verdicts below are SUPERSEDED -- do not treat as decision-relevant. ONLINE_EDGE_VERDICT entries are NOT affected by this correction and still stand.
_CORRECTION.reason: The original NOT_WARRANTED_LIKELY_REGRESSION calls (metaqa/webqsp) and WARRANTED_AS_COST_SIMPLIFICATION calls (2wiki/musique/hotpot) were both inferred from Phase 8's direct-edge co-location diagnostic (frac_with_struct_any). Phase 8's own docstring says this is diagnostic, not causal: a hyperedge is multi-way and the GLOBAL partitioning objective can co-locate two nodes with zero direct edge between them via transitive/overlapping-hyperedge structure. A low frac_with_struct_any therefore does not prove KNN/NER CAUSED the co-location -- it is equally consistent with the global objective grouping an indirectly STRUCT-connected neighborhood. Treating that diagnostic as decisive evidence for a partition-rebuild recommendation was an inferential overreach; only an actual repartitioning ablation (same algorithm/params, only the hyperedge family-set input changed) is a valid causal test.
_CORRECTION.actual_causal_test: PHASE 12 (scratchpad/_l1au_p12_factorial.py) -- repartitions H4_SPLIT_PRESERVE under a bit-identical build (same node universe/k/epsilon/seed/split-preserve rule/weighting) with famset in {S, SK, SN, SKN}, and scores each through the unchanged online stack (E0 BASE P50 / E1 historical SAFE / E2 SP1+FULL_C halo / E3 SP1+STRUCT-only halo). famset=SN/SKN additionally fixed a real bug found while building this: _l1hu_build.py's partition-build 'NER' family had been silently using the residualized NERX = NER\STRUCT (via _l1kn_sub.keysets()'s cached 4th return value) instead of canonical/raw NER -- fixed via the new _l1kn_sub.raw_ner_keys(). Also corrected: the shipped H4 partition is famset=SK (STRUCT+KNN) only -- NER was NEVER part of any historical partition-build (confirmed via BUILD_MANIFEST.json grep across every rule/corpus); the open question is S vs SK vs SN vs SKN, not 'STRUCT alone vs the current all-family mix'.
_CORRECTION.rollout_plan: metaqa first (cheapest KB corpus, and the one Phase 8's diagnostic flagged as highest-risk) with a hard gate on Phase 12's E2 cell (SP1+FULL_C halo, the actual shipped online mechanism); PASS only if no famset shows a significant McNemar regression vs the shipped SK reference. Competitive survivors then roll out to squad/musique/2wiki locally, pruned aggressively, then at most SK+one alternative go to webqsp/hotpot.
_CORRECTION.superseded_field: PURE_STRUCT_PARTITION_EXPERIMENT_WARRANTED and pure_struct_reason, per corpus below, in the original PER_CORPUS array.

_PHASE12_FINAL_VERDICT.status: CLOSED. Full 4-way (S/SK/SN/SKN) factorial complete on all 4 local corpora; SK-vs-SKN-only (per the user's staged webqsp-first-then-hotpot promotion gate, no S/SN rebuild there) complete on webqsp and hotpotqa_clean. All 6 corpora tested. FINAL DECISION: SK_STAYS -- see 'final_decision' below. S and SN remain REFUTED as universal replacements for SK. SKN never significantly regresses anywhere across all 6 corpora, but delivers no significant win on the primary (shipped E2) gate on ANY corpus either, at real and sometimes substantial added offline cost -- it does not clear the bar for promotion.

_PHASE12_FINAL_VERDICT.skn_across_all_16_cells_LOCAL4_ONLY: [SUPERSEDED BY skn_across_all_24_cells BELOW, kept verbatim for the record] Of the 16 (corpus x E-cell) comparisons across the 4 local corpora, SKN vs SK is positive-or-exactly-tied in 12, and negative in only 4 (squad E2/E3 at -0.0005 each; 2wiki E2/E3 at -0.0020/-0.0015) -- every one of those 4 negatives is non-significant and under 0.002 in magnitude. Zero significant regressions anywhere; one significant win (musique_clean E1, historical-SAFE cell, not the shipped E2 cell itself -- E2's musique gain of +0.0055 is directionally the same but does not clear significance, p=.126).
_PHASE12_FINAL_VERDICT.skn_across_all_24_cells: Extending to all 6 corpora (24 = 6 corpus x 4 E-cell comparisons): SKN vs SK is positive-or-exactly-tied in 16, negative in 8 (the original 4 local negatives, plus webqsp E2/E3 at -0.0028/-0.0014 and hotpotqa_clean E2/E3 at -0.0010/-0.0010). Every one of the 8 negatives is non-significant; the largest is webqsp E2 at -0.0028. Zero significant regressions anywhere across all 24 cells; exactly one significant win anywhere (musique_clean E1, +0.0125, p=.00155) -- not on the primary shipped E2 cell on any corpus.
_PHASE12_FINAL_VERDICT.cross_corpus_reversal_factorial_effects: [from the 4-way S/SK/SN/SKN factorial, LOCAL 4 CORPORA ONLY -- webqsp/hotpotqa_clean never rebuilt S/SN so this factorial does not extend to them] KNN_ON_STRUCT (=SK-S effect) flips sign between metaqa and the other three: negative-to-neutral on metaqa (KNN doesn't help there) but strongly POSITIVE on squad/musique/2wiki (up to +0.0465 on musique E2). This falsifies the metaqa-only reading (recorded early in Phase 12 and now corrected) that 'KNN was never pulling weight' -- that was a metaqa-specific artifact. NER_ON_STRUCT is positive on all 4 corpora but alone isn't enough to make SN safe (SN still sig-regresses on squad+musique). FAMILY_INTERACTION (SKN-SK-SN+S) is NEGATIVE in every single cell across all 4 corpora -- KNN's and NER's contributions are substantially redundant with each other, not additive -- but the redundancy never pushes SKN below SK; it only caps how much SKN can gain on top of SK's already-captured KNN benefit.
_PHASE12_FINAL_VERDICT.cross_corpus_reversal_online_architectur: NEW cross-corpus finding from the webqsp+hotpotqa_clean rollout, ORTHOGONAL to the factorial-effects reversal above -- this one is about the SKN_E3-vs-SK_E2 architecture question (does STRUCT-only online serving under an SKN partition match FULL_C online serving under SK?), i.e. D_vs_A_ARCH in STEP4_SIX_CORPUS_ABCD_TABLE.json. Accuracy ties within noise on ALL 6 corpora (macro delta -0.0008, worst -0.0049 on webqsp, zero significant regressions). But the COST direction of that architecture swap flips: D is 15.9-50.8% CHEAPER in latency than A on 5/6 corpora (metaqa/squad_clean/musique_clean/2wiki_clean/webqsp), yet 48.5% MORE EXPENSIVE on hotpotqa_clean specifically. Root cause: hotpotqa_clean's raw NER-mention density (4.34M) is ~3.5x webqsp's (1.22M), so its STRUCT-only online candidate set no longer shrinks relative to FULL_C the way it does on every other corpus. Practical meaning: SKN_STRUCT_ONLINE is architecturally sound (never an accuracy risk) but NOT a universal free latency win -- a blanket 'always serve STRUCT-only under SKN' policy would make hotpot slower, not faster. Separately, B_vs_A_online_cost_baseline (STRUCT-only online serving under the UNCHANGED SK partition, no SKN involved) is a SIGNIFICANT REGRESSION on metaqa alone (-0.0095, p=6.6e-05) -- confirming FULL_C online serving is doing real, non-redundant work on metaqa today regardless of which partition family is used underneath.
_PHASE12_FINAL_VERDICT.final_six_corpus_table: see halo_family_factorial/STEP4_SIX_CORPUS_ABCD_TABLE.json for the complete A=SK+FULL_C/B=SK+STRUCT_ONLY/C=SKN+FULL_C/D=SKN+STRUCT_ONLY table (accuracy, McNemar, latency, candidates, build+partition cost) across all 6 corpora, plus macro/worst summaries. Headline: C_vs_A macro=-0.0001/worst=-0.0028(webqsp,ns); D_vs_A_ARCH macro=-0.0008/worst=-0.0049(webqsp,ns); zero significant regressions and zero significant wins in either comparison, on any corpus.
_PHASE12_FINAL_VERDICT.cost_table_offline_and_online: see halo_family_factorial/STEP4_SIX_CORPUS_ABCD_TABLE.json (BUILD/PARTITION blocks per corpus) for full detail. Offline: SKN's pins exceed SK's on every corpus, from +33% (webqsp) to +126% (2wiki_clean); the 2 large corpora required dedicated Modal partition jobs SK never needed to instrument (webqsp SKN: 336GB-tier job, 140.6GB peak/54.9min; hotpotqa_clean SKN: 262.8GB peak/56.4min) -- SK's own historical partition RAM/time was simply never recorded (null in every corpus), so SKN is the ONLY family with a measured offline cost, and that cost is strictly additive (a full extra partition job), not something SK pays today. Empirical finding of independent value: partition peak RAM tracks N/k (node count / block count), not pins -- hotpot's pins nearly doubled SK->SKN (+89%) while peak RAM grew only +7%, since N/k was held fixed by construction. Online: candidate volume and latency for FULL_C vs STRUCT-only, SK vs SKN, all 6 corpora -- see cross_corpus_reversal_online_architecture_cost above for the headline finding.

reasoning_by_criterion.1_universal_accuracy: Clean tie across all 6 corpora on both primary comparisons. C_vs_A (swap partition family only, same online serving): macro delta -0.0001, worst -0.0028 (webqsp). D_vs_A_ARCH (fully simplified SKN+STRUCT-only vs shipped SK+FULL_C): macro delta -0.0008, worst -0.0049 (webqsp). Neither approaches the noise floor on any corpus.
reasoning_by_criterion.2_significant_wins_losses: Zero significant regressions anywhere in the final A/B/C/D comparisons (24 corpus x cell-pair tests, all ns). Zero significant WINS either -- the one significant result in the entire Phase 12 study (musique_clean E1, +0.0125, p=.00155) is on the historical-SAFE cell, not the shipped E2 cell, and does not survive to the shipped comparison (musique E2/C_vs_A is +0.0055, ns, p=.126). Per the user's explicit instruction not to promote on zero-regressions alone: there is also no win to promote on.
reasoning_by_criterion.3_online_simplicity: SKN+STRUCT-only (D) IS architecturally simpler than SK+FULL_C (A) -- fewer online halo tiers to serve. But the simplification's practical benefit (lower latency) is corpus-conditional, not universal: it helps 5/6 corpora and actively hurts hotpotqa_clean (+48.5% latency). A universal policy cannot cleanly claim this as a win.
reasoning_by_criterion.4_online_latency: Same conclusion as (3) via the direct measurement: -15.9% to -50.8% on 5 corpora, +48.5% on hotpotqa_clean. Net: real but non-universal, and the failure case is one of the two large/production-scale corpora, not a minor one.
reasoning_by_criterion.5_offline_storage_build_cost: SKN costs strictly MORE than SK on every single corpus with no exception -- more hyperedges, more pins, larger serialized hypergraphs, and (where measured) real partition RAM+wall-time that SK's own shipped partitions never had to pay. On the 2 large corpora this is not a marginal cost: dedicated 336GB-tier / ~55-56 minute Modal jobs, one-time but real, and would need to be repeated for any future corpus added to the universal family.

final_decision.conclusion: By the user's own explicit rule ('do not choose SKN merely because it has zero regressions'), SKN does not clear the bar: criterion (1)-(2) are a clean tie with no upside to bank, and criteria (3)-(5) all favor SK once the online-latency benefit is recognized as corpus-conditional rather than universal, and the offline cost is recognized as strictly additive rather than neutral. SK_STAYS as the universal partition-build family-set. SKN is not promoted, but is fully validated as a SAFE non-regressing alternative should a future need arise (e.g. if a corpus-specific deployment wants the latency win on the 5 corpora where it holds) -- it is shelved, not refuted. PURE_STRUCT_PARTITION_EXPERIMENT_WARRANTED remains NO (S and SN stay REFUTED as universal replacements, unchanged from the local-4 verdict).

open_items_not_closed_by_this_verdict: the 3-cell membership-vs-score-mass online control (FULL-membership/full-scoring, FULL-membership/STRUCT-scoring, STRUCT-membership/STRUCT-scoring) requested separately from this partition-build question is still not built -- unrelated to partition-BUILD family choice, applies to the online G1/G3 stack instead, and was never part of this gate.

no promotion has been executed and none is planned given SK_STAYS -- BUILD_MANIFEST.json/shipped assignments are UNCHANGED; SKN partitions exist only under scratchpad/_l1hu/parts (local 4 corpora) plus the Modal-built webqsp/hotpotqa_clean SKN .npy/.stats.json pairs, not as the live CURRENT assignment for any corpus.

if a future corpus-specific need arises for SKN+STRUCT-only's latency win, re-check hotpotqa_clean-like high-NER-density corpora specifically before deploying it universally -- the cost-direction reversal is real, not noise.
